question.:question/problem:
Without using a calculator, find the exact value of

$$
\left(\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)-\cos\left(165^{\circ}\right)\right)^2
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Expand the square and use the Pythagorean identity.

Set $x=165^{\circ}$.

$$
\begin{aligned}(\sin x-\cos x)^2 &= \sin^2 x-2\sin x\cos x+\cos^2 x \\ &=1-2\sin x\cos x \\ &=1-\sin(2x)\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}2\sin x\cos x &=\sin(2x) \\ &=\sin\left(330^{\circ}\right) \\ &=- \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Substitute this exact value:

$$
\begin{aligned}\left(\sin\left(165^{\circ}\right)-\cos\left(165^{\circ}\right)\right)^2&=1-\left(- \frac{1}{2}\right) \\ &=\frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: Real constant angle; both sine and cosine are nonzero.
